finding: Slovak firms face margin compression as input costs far outpace selling prices
bullets: Slovak firms (n=224) expected production input prices to rise 7.33% over the next 12 months, 3.58 pp above their 3.75% selling price expectation (n=222), pointing to ongoing margin compression.

Slovak firms anticipated average wage growth of 4.12% (n=233), 1.52 pp above the euro area's 2.60% (n=4,941), with both input price and wage expectations exceeding selling price expectations — signalling higher cost pressures.
Slovak firms' 12-month inflation expectations eased to 4.68% (n=193), down 0.29 pp from wave 38's 4.97%, remaining 0.80 pp above the euro area's 3.88% mean.
chart_subtitle: Slovak firms expect input prices to rise 7.33% in 12 months.
